Container.Name: subarr-subgen-parakeet-gpu
Container.Overview:
subarr-subgen (McCloudS/subgen + subarr patches) with a Parakeet transcription backend. Subtitles are transcribed by NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (int8) on the CPU through onnx-asr - no GPU or VRAM used. This is the CUDA image (:gpu, gpu branch): Parakeet still runs on the CPU, but the Whisper model used for language detection and for languages Parakeet cannot handle runs on the NVIDIA GPU (needs the Nvidia-Driver plugin). VRAM is only used while Whisper is loaded and is freed after MODEL_CLEANUP_DELAY.
Bazarr: Settings - Providers - Whisper, endpoint http://UNRAID-IP:9006, and raise the transcription timeout (e.g. 10800).
Language: the language Bazarr sends is always used. Only when it is missing does the small WHISPER_MODEL detect it (DETECT_LANGUAGE_LENGTH seconds). Parakeet covers 25 European languages; other languages and translate requests fall back to WHISPER_MODEL.
Memory: nothing is loaded until the first job; models unload MODEL_CLEANUP_DELAY seconds after the queue empties. Models are stored in the Models path.
CPU pinning: set it below. Parakeet uses one thread per pinned CPU unless PARAKEET_THREADS is set.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: API port for Bazarr/subarr. Container port must match WEBHOOKPORT.

Config.Name: Internal WEB Port
Config.Description: Port subgen listens on inside the container. Keep equal to the Web Port container port.

Config.Name: Data Storage (Media)
Config.Description: Your media. Bazarr, Plex and subgen must see the same files at the same paths (or use USE_PATH_MAPPING).

Config.Name: Models / AppData
Config.Description: Model storage: Parakeet + Silero VAD (onnx-asr/ subfolder, ~1 GB) and the Whisper detection model.

Config.Name: Path Allowlist
Config.Description: subarr-subgen only serves paths under these container paths (colon-separated). Must cover the media mount, or every request returns 403.

Config.Name: Transcribe Backend
Config.Description: parakeet = Parakeet on CPU (this fork). whisper = stock subgen behaviour.

Config.Name: Hardware Option
Config.Description: Device for the Whisper detection/fallback model (Parakeet always runs on CPU). cuda = GPU.

Config.Name: WHISPER_MODEL
Config.Description: With the Parakeet backend this model only detects missing languages and transcribes languages Parakeet can't. On the GPU large-v3-turbo is fast. With TRANSCRIBE_BACKEND=whisper it does all transcription (stock subgen).

Config.Name: Compute Type
Config.Description: Whisper compute type. int8_float16 = lowest VRAM on GPU.

Config.Name: Parakeet Model
Config.Description: v3 = 25 European languages (auto-detects). v2 = English only.

Config.Name: Parakeet Quantization
Config.Description: int8 = ~1 GB RAM, fastest on CPU. none = fp32 (~2.5 GB RAM, slightly more accurate, slower).

Config.Name: Parakeet Threads
Config.Description: 0 = one thread per CPU pinned to this container.

Config.Name: Parakeet Fallback
Config.Description: What to do with languages Parakeet can't transcribe and translate requests: whisper = use WHISPER_MODEL, none = fail the job.

Config.Name: Concurrent Transcriptions
Config.Description: Jobs run at once. 1 is best on CPU (parallel jobs just split the same cores).

Config.Name: Detect Language with 'x' Seconds
Config.Description: Audio sampled (Whisper language detector, up to 10 x 30 s windows) when no language is supplied.

Config.Name: Housekeeping Behaviour
Config.Description: Unload the models from RAM when the queue is empty (after MODEL_CLEANUP_DELAY).

Config.Name: cleanup
Config.Description: Seconds of idle time before models unload.

Config.Name: Eager Model Load
Config.Description: true = download/load models at container start. false = load on first job.

Config.Name: Transcribe or Translate
Config.Description: transcribe = subtitles in the audio language (Parakeet). translate goes to the Whisper fallback.

Config.Name: Process Added Media (Plex/Jellyfin)
Config.Description: Transcribe when the media server webhook reports new media. Off: Bazarr drives transcription.

Config.Name: Process Media On Play (Plex/Jellyfin)
Config.Description: Transcribe when playback starts. Off: Bazarr drives transcription.

Config.Name: Plex Server Address
Config.Description: Only needed for the Plex webhook (disabled above).

Config.Name: PLEXTOKEN
Config.Description: Only needed for the Plex webhook (disabled above).

Config.Name: Lyric Files
Config.Description: Write LRC instead of SRT for audio files.

Config.Name: Skip if Subs Exist
Config.Description: Skip when an external subtitle in NAMESUBLANG already exists.

Config.Name: Debug Logging
Config.Description: Verbose logs.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: GPU UUID from the Nvidia-Driver plugin page, or all.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: Leave as compute,utility.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for files written.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for files written.
